name: nvoy
description: Scoped, revocable data delegation to agentic workflows over nostr. Agent side mounts as an MCP server. Built on NIP-DA Scoped Data Grants.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run ledger && npm run conformance && npm run nopersist
scripts.sync-lib: for f in nipxx.mjs liverelay.mjs relay.mjs; do { echo "// vendored from JAFairweather/nostr-scoped-data-grants @ $(git -C ../nip-demo rev-parse --short HEAD) — do not edit; npm run sync-lib"; cat ../nip-demo/$f; } > lib/$f; done
